description: Fixture r-cplx-rebuild-cx-attach: table T(ID COUNTER primary key, Name) with one attachment field Att (dbAttachment 101) added through CreateField; source files written by ADODB.Stream into the work directory (att-small.txt 5 bytes, att-page.txt 20,000 patterned bytes, att-noise.bin 20,000 pseudo-random bytes) and loaded through FileData.LoadFromFile: p1 (small), p2 (page-spanning plus small: two attachments), p3 (empty group), p4 (noise), p5 (inserted then deleted), p6 (small, after the deletion). Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128) and DAO/DDL calls; every call is recorded and the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, Name TEXT(20))
